answer: Make every new identity earn its place through a circle of peers who stake their own standing on its behaviour, like boats tied to one wharf vouching for a newcomer before it may trade. Each sponsor can vouch for only a handful of agents, and if the newcomer cheats, the sponsors lose part of their stake, so vouching is never handed out in a meadow of strangers. A sybil farm must buy genuine sponsors one by one, and its crystal-clear trail of shared sponsors exposes the whole cluster at once.
